title: Kissed with Fire Polish Chicken Pierogi
description: Funky, shattering, cozy polish dish featuring Thai-bird-chili and yakimono-grill, high in protein. A perfect combination of Eastern-European pierogi and Southeast-Asian flavors.
instructions: Combine flour, eggs, and salt to form a dough, knead for 5 minutes, and let rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces, roll out thinly, and cut into rounds.
Season chicken breast with salt and pepper, cook in yakimono-grill at 400°F (200°C) for 10 minutes per side.
Finely chop Thai bird's eye chilies, mix with yakitori sauce.
Spread a spoonful of caramelized onions on each pierogi round, top with shredded cheddar cheese, and a piece of cooked chicken breast.
Fold the dough in half, press edges to seal, and press the edges with a fork to prevent them from opening during cooking.
Heat a large skillet with 2 tablespoons of unsalted butter over medium heat, cook the pierogi for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped chives and a drizzle of yakitori sauce.
